method: Eight named development request streams. At five minutes before the oldest response deadline, form feasible sequential pairs among all then-known requests. Assume independent logistic wins, slope14 and threshold1.4, no trust uplift, and quoted alternatives all feasible under the earliest offered deadline. Compare independent optimal prices with a branch-and-bound certified joint price optimum, crediting both policies the route saving when both win.
limitations: This is a model-based screen, not measured profit or a global bound on dispatch performance.
No future arrivals enter a decision, but counterfactual capacity, prices, dealer option choice and driver behavior are not simulated.
Actual order wins are correlated through market conditions; the independent conditional-win assumption can be wrong.
Pairs use the existing conservative routing helper and20% fee discount cap. This is not a proof against more ambitious acquisition or route planning.
